detailed_description: The Area Chart Generator helps you turn ordered data into a filled trend chart directly in your browser. It works well for showing growth, decline, and cumulative movement across dates, categories, or ranked steps when a plain line chart feels too light. You can enter labels and values, adjust the chart title, colors, legend, and layout options, then review the live preview before exporting the finished visual as PNG or SVG for slides, dashboards, or documentation.
usage_steps: Enter your labels and values in the editor, or start from the sample rows already loaded on the page.
Set the chart title and confirm the category order matches the story you want to tell.
Adjust colors, legend visibility, and other display options until the filled areas are easy to read.
Review the live preview and refine labels, values, or spacing where the chart feels crowded.
Export the final area chart as PNG or SVG when the visual is ready to share.
usage_examples: Show monthly signups or revenue so the audience can quickly see the overall trend and scale.
Visualize support ticket volume across a release cycle to highlight peaks and quieter periods.
Present cumulative progress toward a quarterly goal in a report or product update.
